notes.title: Introducing Five New AgeOfGames Bundles on Steam!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce the launch of five exciting new game bundles on Steam, each tailored to bring you a unique experience from our rich library. Whether you’re into action-packed adventures or intricate strategies, there’s something here for everyone. Here’s a look at each bundle:

The New Bundles:

[b]AgeOfGames - OldSchool Turn-Based Strategy Bundle[/b]

Immerse yourself in our classic strategy games! This bundle gathers all our beloved turn-based strategy titles, perfect for players who enjoy tactical depth and strategic planning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597132/16a96d2f956fb5d7282a24ece39d3b3d35334c0b.jpg[/img]

[b]The Etrom World Bundle[/b]

Explore the dark, immersive world of Etrom and Chroma Wars. This bundle combines two games with rich storylines and intense gameplay set in our mysterious universe, which has birthed video games, novels, short stories and so much more still to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597132/88fa7e9cbd08054cbcc1c2a6d1fbe484ba533ce1.jpg[/img]

[b]The King Island Bundle[/b]

Dive into the entire King Island series, including the latest installment, King Towers. This bundle is a must-have for fans of action-packed adventures with a side of comedy. The King Island series reveal the story of Kaptivo’s journey through three ARPGs - King Towers is our only Tower Defence game currently available on the store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597132/c4e0a11bb5803425dab0c6bc14f531c158690356.jpg[/img]

[b]The Eukarion Continent Bundle[/b]

Journey through the world of Eukarion, where Fantasy Kommander and the Eukarion Tales series live and breathe fantasy. Set in a shared universe, this bundle delivers an epic fantasy experience with classic RPGs as well as our strategic masterpiece!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597132/1e4b829a7ddf6a06e52e7eceb4407ab79a055ff1.jpg[/img]

[b]The AgeOfGames OldSchool ARPG Bundle[/b]

This collection gathers AgeOfGames’ classic indie action-RPG. Featuring nostalgic visuals and hours of immersive gameplay, this bundle is perfect for those looking to relive the charm of old-school RPGs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597132/af4a1e4fa681668bbaeebf4810c344bce671d6af.jpg[/img]

[b]The Original:[/b]

[b]AgeOfGames - Millennium Artifacts Bundle[/b]

Already available, Discover a grand collection of games that have stood the test of time. This bundle is your gateway to some of AgeOfGames' most cherished titles, all in one place with a generous discount.

Each bundle offers a unique selection of games at a great value, letting you explore the best of AgeOfGames in one purchase. Check them out on Steam now!

notes.title: 🔥 Millennium Artifacts Bundle – Our First AgeofGames Bundle!
notes.notes:
Calling all adventurers, tacticians, and RPG enthusiasts! We're excited to announce the launch of the Millennium Artifacts Bundle, featuring a collection of our top titles at 53% off. Whether you're into action-packed RPGs or strategic tower defense, this bundle has something for you! 💥

Here's what you'll get:

King Island: Dive into an immersive and humorous action RPG. Explore the island, battle enemies, complete quests, and uncover hidden treasures in a world filled with comedy and chaos. Fight crazy cows and level up your hero in this classic ARPG experience!

King Towers: A retro tower defense game where strategy is key! Defend your kingdom from relentless waves of villagers, knights, evil witches, and even cows with dangerous weapons. Keep your gold and mana safe in this fast-paced, challenging game.

Fantasy Kommander: Eukarion Wars: Lead your armies in epic, turn-based tactical warfare. Immerse yourself in a European fantasy world as you navigate four campaigns filled with heroes, quests, and powerful enemies.

Etrom 20th Anniversary Edition: A point & click action RPG set in a dark future. Explore sprawling cities, engage in epic battles, and navigate parallel dimensions in this enhanced version of the original 2003 game.

Chroma Wars: Engage in high-skill strategic battles in this techno-fantasy warfare. Command powerful armies and fight to save your base from abyssal foes in a retro turn-based strategy format.

Eukarion Tales 2: Embark on a dangerous adventure against the forces of Kaos in this classic Flash RPG. Complete quests, gain experience, and equip powerful weapons and armor to face your foes.

Whether you're reliving these Flash classics or playing them for the first time, now's the perfect time to dive in!

Get the Millennium Artifacts Bundle now for 53% off and start your adventure today! ⚔️✨

notes.title: Studio that delayed its game for 22 years reveals new strategy sim
notes.notes:
In recent history, it feels like if a videogame isn't delayed at some point during its pre-launch cycle, something's gone wrong. There's the infamous Cyberpunk 2077, Warhammer 40k: Space Marine 2, then my all-time favorite, Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2. Where there's a game, there's often a delay. Thankfully, these are normally just for a few months, but Kien, an obscure pixel platformer built for the Game Boy Advance was delayed for 22 years, finally releasing in cartridge form back in July, 2024. The developer, AgeofGames, however, isn't done, as it's lready moved onto a brand new project - Homini et Armi: The End of Knights.
